name: Agilix Solutions
old_description: As a renown regional hub for education, healthcare, culture, and commerce, the Columbia community is the largest city in Boone County. The Columbia, Missouri Agilix Solutions branch serves customers throughout the region with an impressive portfolio of electrical supplies, automation innovations, and digital solutions. We also offer a wide variety of valuable services in the Columbia market, designed to help your team get work done effectively, efficiently, and safely. And you get it all with the and the exceptional customer service Agilix Solutions is known for.
about:
Agilix Solutions operates a branch in Columbia, Missouri, at 1815 Vandiver Drive. The company serves the region as a distributor of electrical supplies, automation innovations, and digital solutions.

The branch maintains a local inventory of electrical and automation products from major brands and provides a suite of value-added services including technical support agreements, vendor-managed inventory (VMI) and storeroom management, MRO procurement, power quality and energy assessments, workforce training, emergency support, wire and cable management, installed base evaluations, parts management agreements, asset management, facility identification assessments, drive start-up assistance, thermography scans, delivery, enclosure modification, kitting and product staging, and mobile jobsite product storage. The company leverages a network of locations to source items not in stock.

Agilix Solutions serves contractors, educational institutions, manufacturers, medical device manufacturers, and panel builders and system integrators in the Columbia area.

The company emphasizes its in-house expertise and value-added services designed to keep customer inventory stocked, operations efficient, and teams safe and productive, positioning itself as more than a traditional distributor.
built_on: Extensive local inventory backed by a multi-location network for rapid fulfillment
In-house technical expertise enabling value-added services such as VMI, energy assessments, and training
Comprehensive service portfolio covering MRO procurement, asset management, and preventive maintenance
Focus on exceptional customer service and operational efficiency
type_evidence: We're more than just a distributor for the biggest brands in your industry.
